variants.title: Hall effect in n-type germanium from 77 K to 420 K
variants.sample: Lightly doped n-type germanium slab (2e19 donors per m^3, a property of this crystal)
variants.unknown: the band gap from the intrinsic region and the mobility against temperature
variants.note: The Hall voltage is negative at every temperature (electrons dominate and are the more mobile carriers); it shrinks as the intrinsic carriers take over. Germanium data from Sze, from memory - verify.

source.title: S. M. Sze, Physics of Semiconductor Devices: germanium data
